stem: While the selection from The Boston Girl focuses on a young woman who gains confidence from a mentor, the poem “Sybil Ludington’s Ride” focuses on —

options.label: A
options.text: a young woman who serves as a mentor

options.label: B
options.text: a young woman who seeks a mentor but is unable to find one

options.label: C
options.text: a young woman whose confidence in others betrays her

options.label: D
options.text: a young woman whose confidence inspires others
